# chiaroscuroflow

Chiaroscuroflow is a dual light and dark theme with smooth gradients, Manrope for body text, Nunito Sans for headers, and text-shadowed headings for readability. Colors, backgrounds and gradients are customizable through the Style Settings plugin, and gradients are omitted when exporting to PDF.

![chiaroscuroflow screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/quinta0/chiaroscuroflow/HEAD/cover.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "chiaroscuroflow"
    author: "quinta0"
    repo:   "quinta0/chiaroscuroflow"
    slug:   "chiaroscuroflow"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/chiaroscuroflow"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/quinta0/chiaroscuroflow"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/quinta0/chiaroscuroflow/HEAD/cover.png"

    modes: ["light", "dark"]
    about: "Apply a dual light/dark theme with smooth gradients, elegant fonts (Manrope body, Nunito Sans headers), and text-shadowed headings for improved readability. Customize colors, backgrounds and gradients via the Style Settings plugin and export clean PDFs with gradients omitted for print."
}
```
